Public Function Make(ByVal path As String, ByVal dressed As Boolean) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, c As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "One"
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
    ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
    ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
    If dressed Then
        Set c = ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, xlColumnClustered).Chart
        c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
        c.HasTitle = True
        c.ChartTitle.Text = "Mine"
        c.Legend.Left = 10
        c.PlotArea.Width = 200
        c.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True
        c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 65280
        c.SeriesCollection(2).Trendlines.Add
    Else
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart
        c.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
    End If
    wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
End Function

Private Sub Edit(ByVal which As Long, c As Object, co As Object, r As Variant)
    Select Case which
    Case 1: c.HasTitle = True: r = c.HasTitle
    Case 2: c.HasTitle = False: r = c.HasTitle
    Case 3: c.HasTitle = True: c.HasTitle = False: r = c.HasTitle

    Case 8: c.HasLegend = True: c.Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionTop: r = c.Legend.Position
    Case 9: c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = True: c.Axes(xlValue).AxisTitle.Text = "V": r = c.Axes(xlValue).AxisTitle.Text
    Case 10: c.Axes(xlValue).MaximumScale = 50: r = c.Axes(xlValue).MaximumScale
    Case 11: c.Axes(xlValue).HasMajorGridlines = False: r = c.Axes(xlValue).HasMajorGridlines
    Case 12: c.SeriesCollection(1).Name = "N": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Name

    Case 14: c.ChartArea.Font.Size = 14: r = c.ChartArea.Font.Size
    Case 15: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Font.Bold = True: r = c.ChartTitle.Font.Bold
    Case 16: c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB

    Case 19: c.ChartType = xlLine: r = c.ChartType

    Case 33: c.Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionBottom: r = c.Legend.Position
    Case 34: c.Legend.Position = c.Legend.Position: r = c.Legend.Position
    Case 35: c.Axes(xlValue).MinimumScale = 1: r = c.Axes(xlValue).MinimumScale

    Case 39: c.Axes(xlValue).MaximumScale = 50: r = c.Axes(xlValue).MaximumScaleIsAuto
    Case 40: c.Axes(xlValue).HasMajorGridlines = False: c.Axes(xlValue).HasMajorGridlines = True: r = c.Axes(xlValue).HasMajorGridlines
    Case 41: c.Axes(xlCategory).HasMajorGridlines = True: r = c.Axes(xlCategory).HasMajorGridlines
    Case 42: c.Axes(xlValue).HasMinorGridlines = True: r = c.Axes(xlValue).HasMinorGridlines
    Case 43: c.Axes(xlValue).HasMinorGridlines = True: c.Axes(xlValue).HasMinorGridlines = False: r = c.Axes(xlValue).HasMinorGridlines
    Case 44: c.SeriesCollection(1).Name = "N": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Case 45: c.SeriesCollection(1).Name = "=One!$B$1": r = c.SeriesCollection(1).Name
    Case 46: r = c.Legend.Position

    Case 48: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Text = "a" & vbLf & "b": r = c.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 49: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Text = "a" & vbCr & "b": r = c.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 50: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Text = "": r = c.ChartTitle.Text

    Case 52: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Text = "T": c.ChartTitle.Text = "U": r = c.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 53: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Caption = "T": r = c.ChartTitle.Caption
    Case 54: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Text = "T": c.HasTitle = False: c.HasTitle = True: r = c.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 55: c.HasTitle = False: c.HasTitle = True: r = c.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 56: c.HasTitle = True: c.ChartTitle.Formula = "=One!$B$1": r = c.ChartTitle.Text
    Case 57: c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = True: r = c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle
    Case 58: c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = True: r = c.Axes(xlValue).AxisTitle.Text
    Case 59: c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = True: c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = False: r = c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle
    Case 60: c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = True: c.Axes(xlValue).AxisTitle.Text = "V": c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = False: c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = True: r = c.Axes(xlValue).AxisTitle.Text
    Case 61: c.Axes(xlCategory).HasTitle = True: c.Axes(xlCategory).AxisTitle.Text = "K": r = c.Axes(xlCategory).AxisTitle.Text
    Case 62: c.Axes(xlValue).HasMinorGridlines = True: c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle = True: r = c.Axes(xlValue).HasTitle
    Case 63: c.Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionTop: c.Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionLeft: r = c.Legend.Position
    End Select
End Sub

Public Function Act(ByVal path As String, ByVal out As String, ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, co As Object, c As Object, r As Variant, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set co = wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1)
    Set c = co.Chart
    On Error Resume Next
    Edit which, c, co, r
    s = Err.Number & " " & TypeName(r) & " " & r
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.SaveAs out, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    wb.Close False
    Act = s
End Function
